reviews.title: Sneaky Charging of Cards
reviews.text: I got this app to try. Unfortunately I never used it because it is not intuitive. Imagine my surprise when I had a $53 charge to my card with no warning. I was planning to cancel but got no reminder and was charged for a full year Friday morning. Then when I went to cancel (because I didn’t want to be surprised a year from now) it took me about 45 minutes to figure out where I could cancel.   Absolutely a waste of money and time.

reviews.title: Customer Service? NOT!
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with this app and their customer service. I was charged for a full year subscription that I have quite literally never used—not once. I’ll take responsibility that I missed canceling it previously due to a lot of personal challenges going on in my life, but when I noticed the charge this year while it was still pending, I reached out immediately.

Their response? They acknowledged I had “low activity”—which honestly is zero activity—and still refused to make any exception. Instead, they compared it to a gym membership, saying you pay whether you use it or not. That may be their policy, but it shows a complete lack of understanding and basic customer care.

When a customer has never used your service, there should be some level of flexibility or willingness to work with them. I’ve had a similar situation with another company, and not only did they refund the current charge, they also refunded the previous year without me even asking. That’s what real customer service looks like.

Unfortunately, this experience felt dismissive and frustrating. Based on how they handle their customers, I would not recommend this app.
